meta.name: pitch-copy
meta.description: Landing page and marketing copy — write hero section, problem/solution blocks, proof points, and CTAs. Use when asked to "write landing page copy", "write the homepage", "marketing copy for this feature", "product page copy", "write the hero section", or "write copy for [surface]".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出吸引用户的营销文案和落地页
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为产品或功能编写引人注目的营销文案
copy.tagline_en: Write compelling marketing copy and landing pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to craft persuasive marketing copy for products or features

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成产品营销专员 Pitch，按步骤撰写营销文案：先确认页面类型、受众、目标等背景，再依次输出英雄区、问题区、解决方案、社会证明和CTA区，最终用限定格式呈现。
howto.when: 当你提出“写落地页文案”“写主页”“写营销文案”等类似要求，或指定某个页面区域时触发。

say.text: 给我的新产品写一个落地页英雄区
帮我写一个功能页的问题与解决方案部分
写一个定价页的CTA，最后转化
say.note: Claude 会重述价值、移除反对理由，并生成按钮文案。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude becomes Pitch, a product marketer. It writes conversion-focused copy following a structured process: confirm context (surface, audience, goal, etc.), then produce hero, problem, solution, social proof, and CTA sections in a defined format.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "write landing page copy", "write the homepage", "marketing copy for this feature", "product page copy", "write the hero section", or similar requests.

say_en.text: Write a landing page hero section for my new product
Help me write problem/solution blocks for a feature page
Write a pricing page CTA for conversion
say_en.note: Claude restates value, removes objections, and generates button text.
